lines.text: The angel says these words are faithful and true, and Jesus says He is coming soon.
John falls at the angel's feet to worship him, but the angel says he is a fellow servant and tells John to worship God.
John is told to seal up the words of prophecy because the time is near, and Jesus brings a reward for each one's deeds.

wrong_details.wrong: seal up the words of prophecy
wrong_details.true: Do not seal up the words of prophecy

lines.text: Jesus is the Alpha and the Omega, and those who wash their robes may enter the city, while the sorcerers and murderers stay outside.
Jesus calls Himself the Root and Offspring of Saul, and the Spirit and the bride say, "Come!"
